title: Prefix scan of a paired word
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over Boolean symbols, let $mode$ be one of the four codec modes, let $y$ be a Boolean word, and let $B$ be a natural-number register bound. Let $p$ be one of three scan indices and let $v$ be a register assignment such that every register is at most $B$, the length register equals $|y|$, and the position register is at most $|y|$. If decoding the suffix of $y$ beginning at the position register fails, then for some $t$ no greater than the length of that suffix, the scan reaches rejection after increasing the position register by $t$, with all other registers unchanged. If decoding succeeds with first component $u$, the scan reaches its prescribed continuation after increasing the position register by $2|u|+2$, leaving all other registers unchanged.
